name: October 25 M-route prototype
frame_convention: Vicon world Z-up; virtual body right-handed X-forward Y-left Z-up. Candidate marker-camera mount is used as the virtual body-camera mount until independently measured.
limitations: Prototype parameters; integrators are ideal velocity/acceleration models and do not model mass, thrust, or motors.
Estimated marker-camera mount applied to virtual body axes; measured body/marker/camera transforms can replace it.
Only an assumed floor plane at Z=0 is enforced. Scene obstacles are visual, not collidable.
Baseline tracking controller; upstream FiGS/ACADOS MPC and a learned student are not integrated.
No PX4, ROS, or real-drone command interface.
